key_insight: Chiron jointly learns psychological measurement, individual behaviour prediction, and population-level alignment to better represent human behaviour than general-purpose LLMs.
engineering_relevance: Chiron offers a unified approach for behavioural modelling and population simulation where plausible responses alone are insufficient.
method: Fine-tune an LLM to represent psychological constructs.
Jointly train individual behaviour prediction and population response-distribution alignment.
Evaluate psychological validity, prediction accuracy, and experimental effect-size estimates.
evidence_signal: Across 36 behavioural domains and 78 experiments, the dataset includes 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 decisions, and 99,953 psychometric assessments; evaluations report up to 28.4% relative prediction improvement over frontier LLMs and 82.2–94.3% lower effect-size estimation error.
watch_item: Generalisation to populations and behavioural settings beyond those evaluated remains unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: A Foundation Model to Measure and Predict Human Behaviour
